WITH filtered_fees AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    o.dealedge,
    f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    dealedge,
    AVG(net_fee) AS group_avg_net_fee,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM filtered_fees
  GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge
),
side_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    dealedge,
    AVG(group_avg_net_fee) AS side_avg
  FROM group_stats
  GROUP BY dealedge
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    g.orderslink,
    g.dealedge,
    g.group_avg_net_fee,
    g.record_count,
    s.side_avg,
    (g.group_avg_net_fee - s.side_avg) AS diff
  FROM group_stats g
  JOIN side_averages s ON g.dealedge = s.dealedge
  WHERE g.group_avg_net_fee > s.side_avg
)
SELECT 
  orderslink,
  dealedge,
  group_avg_net_fee,
  record_count,
  diff
FROM filtered_groups
ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
